content.primary_citation: Robustelli et al., J. Am. Chem. Soc. 2022, 144, 6, 2501–2510
content.validation_notes: Validated ligands Fasudil and Ligand-47 as C-terminal binders to Alpha-Synuclein based on Robustelli et al. (2022). Key binding site residues identified in the C-terminal tail (residues 121-140), with Y133, D135, Y136, and E137 showing prominent interactions in simulations and NMR CSP experiments. Ensemble PED00024 contains 575 conformations. Research suggests a 'dynamic shuttling' mechanism where the ligand transitions between weak interactions in the disordered tail. Protocol configured with user-provided SMILES. Experiment set to use 3 clusters for ensemble docking.
